title: Count events in a rolling window
statement: A service receives sorted integer timestamps. For each timestamp t, report how many events fall in the inclusive mathematical interval [t - window, t]. Treat the lower bound as a mathematical integer, even when it is below the signed 64-bit range; avoid overflow when comparing timestamps. This synthetic stream-processing task tests a bounded state rule, not a resume claim.

contract.stdin: First line: integers n and window (0 <= n <= 100000, 0 <= window <= 10^9). Second line: n nondecreasing signed 64-bit timestamps.
contract.stdout: Print n space-separated counts in input order, then newline when n > 0. For n=0 print no output.
contract.complexity_expectation: O(n) time using a moving left boundary, O(n) or less space.
contract.build: Fixed runner image and compiler command; user commands are not accepted.
